memo_attachments_thumbnail_fields.name: memo_attachments_thumbnail_fields
memo_attachments_thumbnail_fields.value:
("memo_attachments"."thumbnail_r2_key" IS NULL AND "memo_attachments"."thumbnail_content_type" IS NULL AND "memo_attachments"."thumbnail_size_bytes" IS NULL)
        OR ("memo_attachments"."thumbnail_r2_key" IS NOT NULL AND "memo_attachments"."thumbnail_content_type" IN ('image/avif', 'image/webp') AND "memo_attachments"."thumbnail_size_bytes" > 0)

memo_attachments_media_dimensions_pair.name: memo_attachments_media_dimensions_pair
memo_attachments_media_dimensions_pair.value:
("memo_attachments"."media_width" IS NULL AND "memo_attachments"."media_height" IS NULL)
        OR ("memo_attachments"."media_width" > 0 AND "memo_attachments"."media_height" > 0)
